model_source_note: Five fixed candidate sources, all seed42; NOT five DPP trained arms or five independent seeds
quality: same physical candidate ADE<=.2 and FDE<=.4

calibration.population: C0 fit GT21719 only; no dev-derived threshold
calibration.amax: linear99.5% of FIT GT12 accelerations INCLUDING junction
calibration.joinmax: linear99.5% of FIT GT first predicted velocity minus observed-last velocity
calibration.sigma: FIT GT IQR for each corresponding reading; nonpositive IQR blocks instead of injecting a floor
calibration.junction_double_count_note: a mean includes a1 plus a separate join penalty; document permits this, report explicitly

dpp.S: exp(-k * sum over12x2 squared coordinate difference)
dpp.k: 1/median squared pair distance on fixed hash128 FIT fresh-B0 predictions only,190 pairs each
dpp.k_note: fixed before diagnostics; this is a stageA scale calibration, not claimed original paper experiment hyperparameter reproduction
dpp.epsilon_note: fixed implementation choice, NO validation sweep; raw/logq always saved; not a quality/motion threshold floor
dpp.EC: trace(I-solve(I+L,I)); spectral independent audit; no jitter, no explicit inverse

turning.undefined: zero observation or future displacement; retained and separately counted
turning.note: fixed descriptive bins, not replacement for C0 stable/transition/change and not tuned on dev

scene.required: independent pedestrian free/obstacle/unknown map + metric SDF and validated coordinate transform
scene.unknown_policy: null/NaN with coverage denominator, never automatically q=1 or q=0

acceptance: Stage A diagnostic only; no vague significance gate invented, no automatic stageB; missing qscene means H1/H3/H4 unresolved
